records.label: spacr.qt.shortcuts#9
records.source: Declared window-wide key sequences can be rebound. The cheat sheet carries a "Change shortcuts…" button that opens a table of the window-wide actions; a key typed there replaces the default, a key already taken by another action is named as a conflict and cannot be saved, and the overrides are kept in the Preferences store under :data:`_KEYMAP_KEY` in Qt's portable spelling, so a keymap saved on one platform reads the same on the others. Keys that belong to a single screen (Annotate, Make Masks, the field browser, Gate Editor) have separate editable rows and saved overrides, applied to both existing and new screens.
records.context: Declared window-wide key sequences can be rebound. The cheat sheet carries a "Change shortcuts…" button that opens a table of the window-wide actions; a key typed there replaces the default, a key already taken by another action is named as a conflict and cannot be saved, and the overrides are kept in the Preferences store under :data:`_KEYMAP_KEY` in Qt's portable spelling, so a keymap saved on one platform reads the same on the others. Keys that belong to a single application view (Annotate, Make Masks, the field browser, Data-selection boundary Editor) have separate editable rows and saved overrides, applied to both existing and new application views.
records.translation: 已声明的窗口级按键序列可以重新绑定。快捷键速查表中的 "Change shortcuts…" 按钮会打开窗口级操作表；在其中输入的按键会替换默认按键。若按键已被其他操作使用，则会指出冲突，且无法保存。覆盖设置以 Qt 的可移植写法保存在首选项存储的 :data:`_KEYMAP_KEY` 下，因此在一个平台上保存的键位映射在其他平台上也能以相同方式读取。属于单个界面（Annotate、Make Masks、视野浏览器、Gate Editor）的按键具有独立的可编辑行和已保存的覆盖设置，并应用于已有和新建的界面。
